method: Exact named Google Maps destinations were matched to current operator or regional-guide addresses. Stable display estimates use the no-ferry route from Seattle so the planning number does not omit ferry queues or sailing time.

reviews.coordinate_source: Google Maps exact named RV park point matched to the operator's published address
reviews.route_note: Uses the no-ferry I-5, Tacoma Narrows, and US 101 route; ferry choices can show a shorter moving time but add fare, queue, and sailing uncertainty.
